title: J001: Add Go mock Central API server with fixtures
summary: Mock Central API server implementation is structurally sound with 93.3% test coverage, correct wire-compatibility with internal/api types, atomic counters verified under -race, and a clean distroless Dockerfile. However, 3 blocking issues prevent approval: (1) a compiled binary committed to the repo root, (2) SSE keep-alive ticker required by the plan is completely missing from the events handler, and (3) golangci-lint errcheck failure on unchecked json.Encode error. Additionally, 2 files are out-of-scope for this feature.

tests_checklist.item: All tests pass with go test -race -count=1
Concurrent counter test with 100 goroutines per endpoint
Wire-compatibility verified via unmarshal into internal/api types
Edge cases: invalid body 400, wrong method 405, unknown route 404

code_quality_checklist.item: Uses only net/http standard library (no frameworks)

security_checklist.item: No compiled binary committed to repo

architecture_checklist.item: Clean separation: library package + cmd entrypoint
Server struct encapsulates mux and counters
Multi-stage Dockerfile with module cache layer
Solution is as simple as possible

dry_yagni_checklist.item: Peer fixture data repeated in register+state handlers

security_findings.description: Compiled ELF binary (8.3MB, ARM aarch64) committed to repository root as 'mockapi'. Binaries must never be tracked in git — they bloat history, are platform-specific, and could contain unexpected code.
security_findings.fix: Remove the binary: git rm mockapi. Add 'mockapi' or '*.exe' and platform binaries to .gitignore.

architecture_findings.description: SSE keep-alive ticker is completely missing. Plan task 1.7 requires: 'Send SSE keep-alive comment (: keep-alive\n) every 15 seconds. Use context cancellation to detect client disconnect.' The implementation sends one SSE event then blocks on <-r.Context().Done() with no periodic writes. The docs at mock-api-server.md:189 promise keep-alive every 15 seconds but the code does not deliver this.
architecture_findings.fix: Add a time.NewTicker(15*time.Second) loop after the initial event that writes ': keep-alive\n' and flushes, using select on ticker.C and r.Context().Done().

architecture_findings.description: StateResponse fixture does not initialize Data and SecretRefs as empty slices. The plan task 1.5 says 'empty but present data and secret_refs arrays'. Since these fields lack omitempty in the API type (internal/api/types.go:86-87), nil slices marshal to JSON null instead of []. Plexd client code may distinguish nil from empty.
architecture_findings.fix: Add 'Data: []api.DataEntry{}, SecretRefs: []api.SecretRef{}' to the StateResponse literal.

issues_found.description: Compiled binary (8.3MB ELF ARM64) committed to repo root. Must never track binaries in git.

SSE keep-alive ticker missing. Plan task 1.7 requires ': keep-alive' comments every 15 seconds. Handler sends one event then blocks forever with no periodic writes. Documented behavior (docs mock-api-server.md:189) does not match code.
issues_found.fix: After sending the initial event, add: ticker := time.NewTicker(15 * time.Second); defer ticker.Stop(); then select loop on ticker.C (write ': keep-alive\n' + flush) and r.Context().Done() (return).

issues_found.description: golangci-lint errcheck: json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v) error return value not checked.
issues_found.fix: Capture and handle the error: if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v); err != nil { /* log or ignore for mock */ }

issues_found.description: StateResponse fixture missing explicit empty slices for Data and SecretRefs. Plan says 'empty but present data and secret_refs arrays'. Nil slices marshal to JSON null, not [].
issues_found.fix: Add Data: []api.DataEntry{} and SecretRefs: []api.SecretRef{} to the StateResponse literal.

issues_found.description: Scope creep: 250-line shell test script for the container workflow (PXD-0036 scope). Not in plan tasks for PXD-0037.
issues_found.fix: Remove from this branch. Submit in a separate PR if needed.

issues_found.description: Scope creep: 211-line shell test script for the plexd Dockerfile (tests plexd binary, ports 9100/51820). Not in plan tasks for PXD-0037.
issues_found.fix: Remove from this branch. Submit in a separate PR if needed.

issues_found.description: Peer fixture data is duplicated between handleRegister (lines 97-114) and handleState (lines 141-157). Identical 2-peer slice.
issues_found.fix: Extract a package-level var fixturePeers = []api.Peer{...} and reference it in both handlers.

issues_found.description: Ping handler returns {"status":"ok"} but plan task 1.2 says 'Handler writes empty JSON object {} to response body'. Deviation from spec, though docs correctly document actual behavior.
issues_found.fix: Either change to writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{}) or update the plan. The current behavior is arguably better for health checks.

suggested_improvements: Extract shared peer fixture data into a package-level variable to eliminate duplication between register and state handlers
Consider adding an env var fallback for the listen address (MOCKAPI_ADDR env var) as mentioned in config docs
Add a TestSSEKeepAlive test that verifies keep-alive comments arrive within ~15s (once the ticker is implemented)
